chapter.li: LEChapter12 Verse1 And it came to pass that the days of Ether was in the days of Coriantumr, and Coriantumr was king over all the land. VerseEnd Verse2 And Ether was a prophet of the Lord; wherefore, Ether came forth in the days of Coriantumr and began to prophesy unto the people, for he could not be constrained because of the spirit of the Lord which was in him. VerseEnd Verse3 For he did cry from the morning even until the going down of the sun, exhorting the people to believe in God unto repentance lest they should be destroyed, saying unto them that by faith all things are fulfilled. VerseEnd Verse4 Wherefore, whoso believeth in God might with surety hope for a better world, yea, even a place at the right hand of God, which hope cometh of faith, maketh an anchor to the souls of men, which would make them sure and steadfast, always abounding in good works, being led to glorify God. VerseEnd Verse5 And it came to pass that Ether did prophesy great and marvelous things unto the people, which they did not believe because they saw them not. VerseEnd

Verse6 And now I, Moroni, would speak somewhat concerning these things. I would shew unto the world that faith is things which are hoped for and not seen. Wherefore, dispute not because 2PP ye see not, for 2PP ye receive no witness — not until after the trial of 2PP your faith. VerseEnd Verse7 For it was by faith that Christ shewed himself unto our fathers after he had risen from the dead, and he shewed not himself unto them until after they had faith in him; wherefore, it must needs be that some had faith in him, for he shewed himself not unto the world VerseEnd Verse8 but because of the faith of men. He has shewn himself unto the world, and glorified the name of the Father, and prepared a way that thereby others might be partakers of the Heavenly gift, that they might hope for those things which they have not seen; VerseEnd Verse9 wherefore, 2PP ye may also have hope and be partakers of the gift if 2PP ye will but have faith. VerseEnd Verse10 Behold, it was by faith that they of old were called after the Holy Order of God. VerseEnd Verse11 Wherefore, by faith was the law of Moses given. But in the gift of the Son hath God prepared a more excellent way, and it is by faith that it hath been fulfilled. VerseEnd Verse12 For if there be no faith among the children of men, God can do no miracle among them; wherefore, he shewed not himself until after their faith. VerseEnd

Verse13 Behold, it was the faith of Alma and Amulek that caused the prison to tumble to the earth. VerseEnd Verse14 Behold, it was the faith of Nephi and Lehi that wrought the change upon the Lamanites, that they were baptized with fire and with the holy ghost. VerseEnd Verse15 Behold, it was the faith of Ammon and his brethren which wrought so great a miracle among the Lamanites. VerseEnd Verse16 Yea, and even all they which wrought miracles wrought them by faith, even those who were before Christ, and also them which were after. VerseEnd Verse17 And it was by faith that the three disciples obtained a promise that they should not taste of death, and they obtained not the promise until after their faith. VerseEnd Verse18 And neither at any time hath any wrought miracles until after their faith; wherefore, they first believed in the Son of God. VerseEnd Verse19 And there were many whose faith was so exceeding strong, even before Christ came, who could not be kept from within the veil, but truly saw with their eyes the things which they had beheld with an eye of faith; and they were glad. VerseEnd Verse20 And behold, we have seen in this record that one of these was the brother of Jared, for so great was his faith in God that when God put forth his finger, he could not hide it from the sight of the brother of Jared because of his word which he had spoken unto him, which word he had obtained by faith. VerseEnd Verse21 And after the brother of Jared had beheld the finger of the Lord because of the promise which the brother of Jared had obtained by faith, the Lord could not withhold anything from his sight; wherefore, he shewed him all things, for he could no longer be kept without the veil. VerseEnd Verse22 And it is by faith that my fathers have obtained the promise that these things should come unto their brethren through the gentiles. Therefore, the Lord hath commanded me, yea, even Jesus Christ. VerseEnd

Verse23 And I said unto him, Lord, the gentiles will mock at these things because of our weakness in writing; for Lord, 2PSI thou hast made us mighty in word by faith, but 2PSI thou hast not made us mighty in writing. For 2PSI thou hast made all this people that they could speak much because of the holy ghost, which 2PSI thou hast given them. VerseEnd Verse24 And 2PSI thou hast made us that we could write but little because of the awkwardness of our hands. Behold, 2PSI thou hast not made us mighty in writing like unto the brother of Jared, for 2PSI thou madest him that the things which he wrote were mighty, even as 2PSI thou art, unto the overpowering of man to read them. VerseEnd Verse25 2PSI Thou hast also made our words powerful and great, even that we cannot write them. Wherefore, when we write, we behold our weakness and stumble because of the placing of our words. And I fear lest the gentiles shall mock at our words. VerseEnd

Verse26 And when I had said this, the Lord spake unto me, saying, Fools mock, but they shall mourn. And my grace is sufficient for the meek, that they shall take no advantage of 2PP your weakness. VerseEnd Verse27 And if men come unto me, I will shew unto them their weakness. I give unto men weakness, that they may be humble. And my grace is sufficient for all men that humble themselves before me; for if they humble themselves before me and have faith in me, then will I make weak things become strong unto them. VerseEnd Verse28 Behold, I will shew unto the gentiles their weakness. And I will shew unto them that faith, hope, and charity bringeth unto me, the fountain of all righteousness. VerseEnd

Verse29 And I, Moroni, having heard these words, was comforted, and said, O Lord, 2PSI thy righteous will be done, for I know that 2PSI thou workest unto the children of men according to their faith. VerseEnd

Verse36 And it came to pass that I prayed unto the Lord that he would give unto the gentiles grace, that they might have charity. VerseEnd Verse37 And it came to pass that the Lord said unto me, If they have not charity, it mattereth not unto 2PSI thee. 2PSI Thou hast been faithful; wherefore, 2PSI thy garments shall be made clean. Verse38 And now I, Moroni, bid farewell unto the gentiles, yea, and also unto my brethren, whom I love, until we shall meet before the judgment seat of Christ, where all men shall know that my garments are not spotted with 2PP your blood. VerseEnd Verse39 And then shall 2PP ye know that I have seen Jesus, and that he hath talked with me face to face, and that he told me in plain humility, even as a man telleth another, in mine own language, concerning these things. VerseEnd Verse41 And now I would commend 2PP you to seek this Jesus of whom the prophets and apostles have written, that the grace of God the Father, and also the Lord Jesus Christ, and the holy ghost, which beareth record of them, may be and abide in 2PP you for ever.
